items.name: Easy
items.description: Training hitch. Weaker, smaller waves and better oil prices. Good for learning a field.

items.name: Normal
items.description: A standard hitch. The way the fields were designed to be played.

items.name: Hard
items.description: Overpressured. Tougher, faster-growing waves and more elites. Every barrel counts.

items.name: Extreme
items.description: HPHT well. Enemies hit hard, elites are common and the night grows fast. Fewer starting barrels.

items.name: Blowout
items.description: Extreme with every one of the 19 mutators switched on. Uncontrolled flow from night one.
